scenes.title: Who authorizes autonomous AI?
lines: When government AI can act, who verifies its authority?

scenes.title: Verified agent collaboration
lines: WAKALA verifies each agent's identity, and limits every delegated action to the citizen's specific request.

scenes.title: Attack blocked at the gateway
lines: In a separate, deliberately triggered test, the Insurance Agent asks for another citizen's record.
WAKALA blocks it before any protected data is returned.

scenes.title: Behaviour Watch and human intervention
lines: Behaviour Watch raises an incident. A verified officer contains it, and reassigns the task to a standby agent.

scenes.title: Safe recovery and accountability
lines: The legitimate service continues, unrelated citizens are unaffected, and every completed action is traceable.

scenes.title: Attack Lab and Document Shield
lines: Attack Lab runs eight attack scenarios. Document Shield quarantines hidden document instructions.

scenes.title: Shadow Mode and evidence
lines: Synthetic benchmarks measure enforcement. Shadow Mode tests policies safely.
